rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: GCIS states that 'On the 14 February 2018 the President of the Republic of South Africa, His Excellency Jacob Gedleyihlekisa Zuma resigned as the President' and that the resignation created a vacancy in the office of the President.

rows.role_title: Acting President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: GCIS states on 15 February 2018 that Deputy President Cyril Matamela Ramaphosa is Acting President until the National Assembly elects the new President, which it would do that afternoon, and that he would not be sworn in again because he had already sworn the Acting President's oath.
